title: Cognos Content Store Health
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSS logs (`microstrategy:dsserror`), Cognos audit (`cognos:audit`), BusinessObjects audit (`businessobjects:audit`), Oracle Analytics usage (`oracle:analytics:usage`), ThoughtSpot audit (`thoughtspot:audit`), QuickSight CloudTrail (`aws:cloudtrail`).
app: Enterprise BI server logs (MicroStrategy, Cognos, SAP BusinessObjects, Oracle Analytics, ThoughtSpot) via Universal Forwarder; platform admin APIs and QuickSight CloudTrail via HEC and the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cognos:audit ("content store" OR "CM-SYS") ("error" OR "warning")
| stats count as events, values(message) as messages by component
| where events>0
| sort - events
description: Monitors IBM Cognos Content Manager for content-store errors and warnings that precede report-server instability and save/schedule failures.
value: The content store is Cognos's system of record; early warnings here prevent a full reporting outage.
implementation: Ingest Cognos audit and CM logs; schedule every 30 minutes and alert on content-store errors.
visualization: Table of component by events with messages, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We keep an eye on the database that Cognos relies on so trouble is caught before reports go down.
